title: Herbalism Basics
description: Sage Brennan has kept Elder Moor's cuts and fevers tended for thirty years, and this deep into autumn his hands shake too badly some mornings to grind herbs fine. He's not looking to be replaced - just to have one more set of hands in camp who knows red herb from rot before the wolves or the roads put someone bleeding in his doorway. He's given you what you need for a first potion.

objectives.description: Speak with Sage Brennan about why he's teaching a stranger
Brew a Health Potion at the alchemy table

notes: Tutorial; no threat by design per spec. Giver motive supplied: Brennan is aging and short-handed for winter. Brennan's shaking hands invented for this quest only - no bible basis, local colour.
